landing.title: Your data rights
landing.intro: You have six rights over your personal data under LGPD (Art. 18) and GDPR (Arts. 15-22). Pick a right below to start a request.

access.label: Access my data
access.description: Get a copy of all personal data we hold about you.

rectification.label: Correct my data
rectification.description: Fix data that is wrong, outdated, or incomplete.

erasure.label: Delete my data
erasure.description: Ask us to erase your data (the right to be forgotten).

portability.label: Export my data
portability.description: Receive a machine-readable copy you can move elsewhere.

restriction.label: Restrict processing
restriction.description: Pause how we use your data while a dispute is resolved.

objection.label: Object to processing
objection.description: Tell us to stop a specific use of your data.

form.reason_placeholder: Tell us why you are exercising this right.
form.reason_required_error: A reason is required for this right.
form.erasure_legal_hold_warning: Some data may be retained per legal hold (fiscal records, audit log). We will tell you what was kept.
form.portability_notice: Exports may take up to 24 hours. The receipt below will hold the download link when ready.
form.objection_purpose_label: Which processing purpose do you object to?
form.submit_error_generic: We could not submit your request. Please try again.
form.submit_error_rate_limit: Daily limit reached. Please try again tomorrow.

reauth.title: Verify your identity
reauth.description: For your safety, please re-authenticate before submitting a data rights request.
reauth.blocked_notice: Form is locked until identity is verified.

status.title: Your data rights requests
status.empty: You have no data rights requests yet.

detail.title: Request detail
detail.data_download_pending: Your export will appear here when ready.
